chapter: Buffalo, Lunceford, Lil Armstrong and Stuff Smith
title: Stuff Smith's band stranded in Philadelphia and taken over by Lil Armstrong
summary: The band played the Lafayette in New York and the Lincoln in Philadelphia, got stranded, was joined by Teddy McRae, and then Lil Armstrong took over the band, Stuff excluded.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Yeah, his daughter, you know. Well, things happen, you know. So, now with this band, Stuff comes to New

York, we had George Clark and two altos, George on tenor and two alto players. Good altos, and clarinet. And we go to -- into the Lafayette. See the Apollo wasn't open in '32, and then we go from there to the Lincoln Theater in Philadelphia, and things didn't work out too good, we're stranded again. So we all get back to Buffalo, and MacRae --

Teddy MacRae, was playing the pit band when we was playing at the Lafayette, and Teddy wanted to join the band, so he did. We didn't have no fourth part, you know, saxophone, we only had three sax, so Teddy joined the band, and just took him a job and bought him a uniform and everything. He said, 'I like this band.' It was a good band. And so we went on back to Buffalo, and we come back in one by one, and Stuff kept this band going pretty good around there, you know. And as big as it was. And here comes Lil Armstrong, and she took over the whole band. She was looking for a band, so we all decided to go with Lil.
Oh, well, that was kind of heartbreaking for Stuff, huh?
No, he knew he could get another one
together. So we all went with Lil, and then she was featuring me as Louis the Second and all that, you know, and it was good.
